verdicts.why_winner:
Y is the only direction that satisfies every owner lock as delivered. The locked palette and the locked primary triplet are used exactly, and the only added colors are allowed status hues. Measured midnight blue is 0 to 6.23% on phone screens and 0.79% on the panel, against a stated 8% and 2% budget, and gray plus off-white stay at or above 93.8% on every screen. Its usage map answers the owner's question in one sentence (ink, not paint: blue only where a decision is made). It backs that with 8 numbered roles, an annotated phone, a never list, do/don't pairs and a measured waffle chart. Its status set is the most complete and the most separable (minimum ink distance 0.081, full AKSİS outputs). Its motion system is the most internally consistent (20 patterns, its own ceilings respected, reduced motion verified).

The other two are behind on constraints, not polish:
- X is the most beautiful but fails O3c by design (59.4% blue QR screen, 91.7% during the flood) and ships overlapping text.
- Z is the purest undertone but reassigns the locked primary triplet, marks records still under review as Var, and looks generic.

Y's defects are QA fixes, not a redesign.

verdicts.none_wows: None wows. X has the polish: Geist typography, a believable camera scene, a memorable success moment. But that moment is a 92% midnight-blue flood the owner explicitly ruled out, and the page ships overlapping text in Platform. Y is correct and complete but reads as Carbon re-skinned, and it has a wrong name sort, 16 px targets, a placeholder camera and a Sonner dependency that contradicts teknik.html. Z is the purest undertone, but its blue barely registers at under 1%, it reassigns the locked primary, mislabels pending records as Var and looks like a template. What is missing is one direction that combines Y's lock compliance and rigor, X's typographic polish and realism, and Z's receipt timeline and X-ray proof, with zero QA defects (sort order, 24 px targets, text collisions, timing ceilings that the demos actually respect).
